title: Icestone
body:
Blue Ice is an ore that was added in v1.45.0. It is exclusively found in the Snowlands.

Description

Blue Ice can only be found in a cave in the Snowlands. This cave has a frozen river passing through it. Its color is a light, cyan-ish blue. Icestone, in all of its forms, has greatly reduced friction. This can be used to build schematics on one's property with a slippery surface.

Unlike many other stone types, Blue Stone has no ores that spawn inside of it.

Trivia

  • During pre-release, Blue Stone would spawn with nuggets of snow inside, that when forged, would yield the same material as Snowtree. Refining it would result in a lighter shade of ice.
  • Blue Ice was one of the first rock types ever added to the game, initially made for the QA testing team to celebrate Christmas 2022 and build snow themed bases.
  • Two Blue Ice filled schematics could be briefly seen in the first trailer[1] of Oaklands. The material would release to the public only during the 2023 Christmas update with the addition of Snowlands.
